bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 61
test "$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll -q | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 62
url="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | sed -n 's/^VIDEOBOT_SHOP_PUBLIC_URL=//p' | head -n 1)"
case "$url" in https://hentaigay.org/|https://*.hentaigay.org/) echo STICKER_GALLERY_PUBLIC_ORIGIN_CONFIGURED=YES;; *) echo STICKER_GALLERY_PUBLIC_ORIGIN_CONFIGURED=NO; exit 71;; esac
docker exec "$cid" node --input-type=module -e 'const r=await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8766/health");if(r.status!==200)process.exit(1)' || exit 72
echo STICKER_SHOP_PRIVATE_HTTP_HEALTH=PASS
echo SINGLE_POLL=PASS
